_readme: The known-good catalog (src/catalog.js): per game exe, the setup PROVEN to run DLSS 5 and the setups known to be dead ends, each with its source. Only real evidence goes here -- a confirmed run on a real install, or a run log -- never a guess. After any edit run `node tools/catalog/build.js`: it checks every entry and rewrites sha256, and the app refuses the file while the hash does not match. `node tools/catalog/build.js --digest <issue body> --source "issue #N" --write` adds a report from an issue's Run digest.

entries.name: Alien: Isolation
entries.notes: 32-bit Direct3D 11 on its own Direct3D: the Feeder's 32-bit add-on hands each frame to the 64-bit helper in host64\, where the neural pass runs. Alt+Home opens the DLSS 5 panel (since 2026-09-16).
sources: live run 2026-09-14: host64\OptiScaler.log, NR over 3600 frames, clean shutdown (src/native-dlss.js, test/legacy.test.js)
live test 2026-09-16: Alt+Home panel on the 32-bit route (src/route.js)

entries.name: ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON

dead_ends.why: the DLSS5 Feeder crashed the neural model on its first frame

entries.notes: Engine Present route ([DlssNr] Placement=present), no Feeder. 4800 frames, 0 model failures, 50-60 fps with 1 pass at 2560x1600. Launch from the app (skips EasyAntiCheat), offline only.

entries.name: Assassin's Creed II
entries.issue: no working route yet (DXVK shakes the camera, ReShade on dgVoodoo2 crashes at the 3D menu); waits for the DLSS5 Feeder's Direct3D 9 backend (Feeder issue #64)

dead_ends.why: DXVK makes the camera shake (a game bug, DXVK issue #2249)
dead_ends.source: live test 2026-09-16/18; app blocks DXVK for early Assassin's Creed (842dccd)

dead_ends.why: ReShade on dgVoodoo2's Direct3D 11 crashes the game as the 3D menu starts (0xC0000005 at 00BE89B7)
dead_ends.source: live test 2026-09-16/18, reproduced with the Feeder and every add-on disabled

entries.notes: 32-bit DirectX 9. Runs with ReShade on its native D3D9, which the Feeder cannot use yet. The game also dies on focus loss (DXVK issue #3653, a game bug).

entries.name: Batman: Arkham Knight
entries.notes: DLSS5 Feeder + OptiScaler as dxgi.dll. Disable Enhanced Godrays in-game. Frame generation: Lossless Scaling, confirmed in a full session 2026-09-10.
sources: live test 2026-09-10: Lossless Scaling 2x, full session, no crash

entries.name: CODE VEIN 2

dead_ends.why: the game ships DLSS under Engine\Plugins; a Feeder beside it loads two DLSS DLLs and crashes

entries.notes: Ships DLSS and Streamline under Engine\Plugins. OptiScaler alone.

entries.name: Cyberpunk 2077

dead_ends.why: OptiScaler's own frame generation with the game's Streamline caused a TDR crash

entries.notes: Native Streamline DLSS. OptiScaler's own frame generation stays off (the app forces it). The game's own DLSS frame generation (2x-4x) runs with DLSS 5 since engine v1.0.40 (VRAM check).
sources: live test 2026-09-16, engine v1.0.40: path tracing + RR + DLSS FG x2-x4 + NR up to 3 passes, no crashes

entries.name: Devil May Cry 5

dead_ends.why: the Feeder's ReShade wraps the D3D12 device, and neither the Feeder nor the Present route ran DLSS 5

entries.notes: RE Engine Present route, no Feeder. Engine v1.0.29 fixed the crash when the game moves its swapchain to R10G10B10A2.

entries.name: Dolphin (emulator)

dead_ends.why: the neural model crashed in its first evaluate on Dolphin's Direct3D 12 backend (same-device D3D12)
dead_ends.source: user report 2026-09-15: dlss5-feed.log evaluate raised 0xC0000005 (app v1.64.0 notes)

entries.notes: Dolphin's Direct3D 11 backend is the way round it (the Feeder then makes its own device); not yet confirmed live.

entries.name: ELDEN RING

dead_ends.why: the DLSS5 Feeder crashed the neural model on its first frame

entries.notes: Engine Present route, no Feeder. 4800 frames, 0 model failures, 45 fps at 2560x1600. Launch from the app (skips EasyAntiCheat), offline only. Load a save: menus have no depth.

entries.name: Mortal Shell II
entries.notes: Ships DLSS under Engine\Plugins\Runtime\Nvidia. OptiScaler alone.

entries.name: RESIDENT EVIL 2
entries.notes: RE Engine Present route: REFramework with its TemporalUpscaler off, OptiScaler as dxgi.dll, no PureDark plugin. 8400 frames, 0 failures, about 65 fps (2026-09-14); no hitches with paced prebuilds (2026-09-18).
sources: live test 2026-09-18, engine 85a64aac (local build): no hitches
